propositions: recheck-review refuses all current-revision findings including bugfix-size-attestation, but the remedy for a missing attestation is ticket state change (run review-plan), not code amendment
bugfix-size-attestation blocks stale after earning plan-review attestation, but copy conditions (NO_CODE_CHANGE, TRIVIAL_REBASE) propagate the -1 vote even though the ticket state has changed
recheck-review should accept a bugfix-size-attestation block only when the single blocking finding is exactly that criterion and the ticket's plan-review attestation classifies as accepted
retrigger eligibility must read only bot vote message and ticket store, never the requesting comment, to prevent spoofing the criterion id or ticket id
parse failures in header count, criterion line, ticket id resolution, or attestation classification must all refuse fail-closed; infra verdicts (unavailable/error) must not auto-accept
